title: Brown Rice with Corn, Fat Added

content.title: About
content.content: Brown rice with corn and added fat is a whole‑grain product that combines rice grains, whole corn kernels, and a small amount of vegetable oil to provide a balanced nutrient profile and a pleasant taste.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Brown rice retains the bran and germ, making it more nutritious than white rice.
Corn adds extra fiber and a subtle sweetness to the blend.
The added vegetable fat improves absorption of fat‑soluble vitamins and increases satiety.
This mix is often used in sports nutrition and child nutrition for higher energy density.
When stored properly, the product keeps its corn aroma for several months.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Both brown rice and corn provide dietary fiber that supports digestive health.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: The blend offers slow‑releasing energy, helping maintain stable blood‑sugar levels.

items.title: Contains healthy fats
items.content: Added vegetable oil (e.g., sunflower oil) supplies essential fatty acids.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The product contains thiamine, niacin, and vitamin B6, which are important for carbohydrate metabolism.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: It provides magnesium, phosphorus and iron, which are vital for bone health and blood formation.

items.title: Corn allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to corn.

items.title: High calorie content
items.content: Added fat increases the energy density, so portion control is recommended.

items.title: Phytic acid content
items.content: Brown rice contains phytic acid, which can reduce mineral absorption when consumed in excess.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Cook the blend like regular rice (water‑to‑grain ratio 2:1), use it in salads, soups, casseroles, or as a side dish for meat. Rinse the rice before cooking to remove excess starch.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct light. For long‑term storage, keep refrigerated to prevent fat oxidation.
